selection_rule: within own-minimum CR + 2 percentage points, shortest penalised time; ties by higher SR then manifest order

tmpc_shared.rationale: the current working point carried forward from the earlier sweep
the current working point carried forward from the earlier sweep

contract.actuator_box_enforcement: saturated at the environment boundary for every arm alike, with violations counted per episode; tolerance 1e-6

resources.machine: local Ryzen 7 5700G, 8 physical / 16 logical cores, 15 GB
resources.development_note: CC D1 is retained as coarse development only; its environment specified OMP_NUM_THREADS but did not enforce OMP_THREAD_LIMIT. D2 and all formal queues enforce four threads; L includes a separately enforced one-thread profile. D1 timings are not hardware benchmarks.
resources.note: the 4090 carries the Bayesian project only and has neither ROS nor acados nor the free disk to install them, so the whole matrix runs on one machine; splitting one method per machine is ruled out by the order in any case

rng_policy.comparators: SH-MPC seeds its scenario sampler from std::random_device and T-MPC++ varies through its parallel branches, so neither is bit-reproducible.  Native parallelism is kept under a common CPU quota, as the order prefers, and the variation is bounded by three independent repeats per layout rather than hidden behind a single-thread run.

statistics.primary: macro over six scenes of SR, CR, TR and penalised time
statistics.aggregation: repeats averaged within a layout first
statistics.resampling: cluster bootstrap over layouts within scene, 10000 draws, seed 20260909
statistics.p_values: two-sided paired layout-cluster sign permutation with plus-one correction
statistics.correction: Holm-Bonferroni over the six pre-registered tests

acceptance_scope.scope: Shared-detector/tracker marginal predictions, adapted planners on the registered CrowdSim unicycle task; not original end-to-end systems or isolated Bayesian necessity.
acceptance_scope.dynamics: 40 development layouts: all four Bayesian diagnostic variants SR=100%, CR=0%; penalised time changes -0.05 to +0.1375 seconds. This is supportive sensitivity evidence, not proof that comparator performance is insensitive. The arc-with-mean-speed diagnostic is an approximation to the native accelerating model.
limitations: Native continuous prediction and CrowdSim turn-then-translate execution differ; disclosed with the same actuator limits for all methods.
SH conversion matches marginal covariances, not the full cross-time covariance of the CV posterior.
Native stochastic solvers are not exactly reproducible across runs; report all three repeats and cluster by layout.
Off-axis/away-from-goal initial-heading probes failed; formal initial heading is goal-aligned for every method.
This comparison alone does not establish novelty or Bayesian indispensability.
acceptance_scope.execution: Preserve running CC D1. Subsequent stages use one local worker, four internal threads, with no scientific candidate changes. Re-run interface tests after transport-only edits before formal freeze.
